limits_intro: ShareIt offers two tiers of service depending on whether you are logged in or accessing the service as a guest. Below are the current limits for each tier.
limits_guest_rate: Rate Limit: Dynamic, based on Server Load and Usage Patterns
limits_auth_rate: Rate Limit: Dynamic, based on Server Load and Usage Patterns. Higher allowance window
limits_auth_device: Device management: File sync between devices
limits_auth_recent: Recent uploads: Browse and re-download your file history from any device
limits_rate_intro: To ensure fair usage and prevent abuse, the following rate limits are enforced per IP address and Session:
limits_rate_restricted: Restricted: No requests allowed (Special Cases or Violations)
limits_rate_note: These limits are deliberately conservative during development and can be adjusted dynamically and automatically.
limits_expiry_text: All uploaded files are automatically deleted from our servers after their retention period expires. We do not retain copies of expired files. The expiration timer starts at the moment the file upload is finalized.
